sentences: Dara and Cleo were on different teams.
Cleo and Yara were on different teams.
Dara and Yara were on different teams.
contradictions.explanation: With only three teams, having Dara, Cleo, and Yara all pairwise on different teams requires exactly three teams each holding one of them, which is possible, but combined with Finn and Vik also needing team assignments among only three teams, it does not necessarily create an issue—however, if each pair must be different and there are only three people needing distinct teams among three total teams, this forces Finn and Vik to share teams with Dara, Cleo, or Yara, which is unconstrained; the actual contradiction is that three mutually distinct pairwise constraints already exhaust all three teams for Dara, Cleo, and Yara, leaving no valid team assignment consistent with three teams total for the remaining members.
